title: Weekly MAP checkpoint: capacity SKU commitment & close timeline
text:
Weekly MAP checkpoint: capacity SKU commitment & close timeline

['From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@kestrelfin.com>, procurement@kestrelfin.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: capacity SKU commitment & close timeline

Emma / Kestrel team —

Thanks for the quick call today. Per our MAP cadence, here’s the concise status update and the SKU-level proposal for Dedicated/Private capacity so we can lock the commitment ahead of your Q2 budget cutoff.

High-level ask from Kestrel (recap):
- Production eval runs begin 2026-04-01.
- Target steady-state throughput: 1.4M tokens/minute US, 600k tokens/minute EU.
- P95 latency goal: <= 250ms for typical chat workloads (<= 512 tokens).
- Data residency: EU workloads must remain in eu-west (no cross-border serving).

Redwood proposed capacity (initial SKU proposal attached):
- US (us-east-1): 5 x NVIDIA H100 80GB (in a dedicated pool) — target sustained throughput ~1.1M tkn/min; burst to ~1.6M tkn/min with autoscaling/burst.
- EU (eu-west-1): 4 x NVIDIA A100 80GB — sustained ~600k tkn/min, lower cost profile for EU evaluation batch runs.
- Embeddings / low-cost inference: 3 x T4 in a separate pool for non-latency-critical tasks and bulk embedding jobs.

Notes: these SKUs are tuned to match the eval profile you shared (mix of chat + long-context document summarization). We flagged an H100-heavy US pool because your US volume is latency-sensitive and needs higher per-card throughput. The attachment (kestrel-map-sku-proposal-v2.xlsx) has the estimated token throughput, p95 latency numbers, and a ballpark monthly committed spend.

MAP checkpoints & owners (short):
- Confirm final SKU counts & regions (owner: Emma / Leo) — due by 2026-03-29 EOD.
- Sign commitment for Dedicated pool (owner: Kestrel procurement) — target 2026-04-15.
- Start private eval deployment (owner: Redwood SRE — Vivek) — target 2026-04-01.
- Evaluation plan: run 3 workload profiles for 7 days each, capture quality/regression signals (owner: Marissa) — start 2026-04-02.

Please review the attached SKU sheet and let me know if you want a quick call tomorrow (30m) to walk numbers. If we get confirmation on the counts by 3/29, we can hold capacity and meet your April timelines.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: kestrel-map-sku-proposal-v2.xlsx (xlsx), kestrel-eval-plan-03-22.pdf (pdf)
', 'From: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@kestrelfin.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leo Bell <leo.bell@kestrelfin.com>, procurement@kestrelfin.com
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: capacity SKU commitment & close timeline

Sergio —

Thanks for the summary and the attachment. A couple quick clarifications from our side after an internal sync:
- EU throughput target is likely to be closer to 750k tkn/min during peak month (we had an underestimate on the call).
- Can you confirm the expected p95 for long-context summarization in EU if we keep A100s vs moving 1 H100 to eu-west for overflow? Latency is less strict for batch summarization but we still need reasonable tail behavior.
- Cost sensitivity: our finance team prefers minimizing committed spend in the first 3 months while we finish evaluation; can we model a 12-week ramp with a lower initial commitment and an option to scale to the full pool?

We’ll aim to confirm internal stakeholders on counts by 3/29 but procurement may request updated numbers with the ramp plan.

—Emma
Director, Platform Strategy
Kestrel Financial
emma.thorpe@kestrelfin.com
', 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@kestrelfin.com>, Leo Bell <leo.bell@kestrelfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: capacity SKU commitment & close timeline

Emma / team —

Thanks for the note. Quick technical takeaways and a practical ramp we can support:

1) EU peak throughput revision -> 750k tkn/min:
- Option A (cost conservative): Keep 4 x A100(80GB) and provision a short-lived overflow H100 (1 x H100) as a burst-only node behind the same routing policy. Expected EU steady p95 for chat: ~220ms; summarization p95 ~320–380ms depending on input length.
- Option B (throughput-first): Move 1 H100 into eu-west and run 5 x A100 + 1 x H100. Estimated sustained throughput ~820–900k tkn/min, p95 for chat <= 240ms. Cost delta ~+18% vs Option A.

2) 12-week ramp plan (recommended):
- Weeks 1–2: Minimal commitment — US: 3 H100; EU: 2 A100. Use burst pools + preemptible capacity to hit occasional peaks.
- Weeks 3–6: Scale to medium — US: 4 H100; EU: 3 A100 + 1 T4 for background jobs.
- Weeks 7+: Full steady-state — US: 5 H100; EU: 4 A100 (or Option B if you choose H100 in EU).

This ramp reduces initial committed spend while preserving the option to have predictable steady-state capacity by Week 7. We can instrument cost burn rates in Redwood Console so finance can see the forecasted monthly obligation at each ramp stage.

Action items assigned (technical):
- Create a ramped pricing sheet with monthly obligations per stage (owner: Vivek) — due 2026-03-26 EOD. [Will upload link here when ready]
- Prepare a private eval deployment playbook (owner: Laura) — due 2026-03-30.
- Finalize evaluation test harness (owner: Marissa) — due 2026-03-31.

I’ll produce a short comparison table (Option A vs B + ramp) and post the link to the MAP doc later today.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of SRE — Redwood Inference
', 'From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thorpe <emma.thorpe@kestrelfin.com>, Leo Bell <leo.bell@kestrelfin.com>, procurement@kestrelfin.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: capacity SKU commitment & close timeline

Emma / Leo —

Appreciate the quick feedback and Vivek’s options. To summarize and keep the MAP moving toward your procurement timeline:

Agreed next steps (finalize by 2026-03-31):
- Kestrel confirms whether EU will accept Option A (A100 + burst H100) or Option B (1x H100 permanently in eu-west). Owner: Emma / Leo — due 2026-03-31 EOD.
- Redwood (Vivek) to upload ramped pricing sheet and an explicit cost delta for Option A vs B. Owner: Vivek — due 2026-03-26 (slipped to 3/29 once the table was richer). Link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/Maps/Kestrel/sku-proposal-v2
- Procurement paperwork: our legal will prepare a capacity commitment term sheet once you confirm counts; target signing 2026-04-15. Owner: procurement@kestrelfin.com / Redwood legal.
- Private eval deployment runbook: Laura to deliver and schedule a dry-run on 2026-03-31. Owner: Laura — due 2026-03-30.
- Evaluation harness & quality checks: Marissa to circulate evaluation prompts and failure/regression criteria by 2026-03-31. Owner: Marissa — due 2026-03-31.

We’ll block a 30m sync for Thursday 4/1 at 10:00am PT for handoff to SRE and to kick off the eval deployment; calendar invite to follow once counts are confirmed.

If you want a single one-page summary for procurement to attach to the PO, I can produce that today.

Best,
Sergio
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
